Workflow.Name: VET-HOME - Portal Message - Send Email and Update Notes with Web Prefix and send reminder
Workflow.Description:
Sends a notification to the Veteran when a CRM user creates a new portal message on a VET-HOME case.
It appends "*WEB* on the notes. Send reminder if message is not viewed. (7 days and 14 days)
